purpose: EkoH expertise profiles and topic relevance vectors for the Canada/Quebec Ethikos demonstration.

canonical_model_notes.baseline_rule: Ethikos source stances remain canonical source facts; EkoH-weighted outputs are declared advisory readings.
canonical_model_notes.ekoh_role: EkoH supplies expertise/ethics/domain/snapshot context; it is not the voting engine.
canonical_model_notes.smart_vote_role: Smart Vote publishes declared, reproducible derived readings and must keep the baseline visible.
canonical_model_notes.profile_scale: Normalized 0..1 DEMO calibration for this sidecar. A 0..10 display value is included only for human readability.
canonical_model_notes.why_normalized: The current repository contains numeric-scale drift between simulation documentation, multidimensional scoring code, and the current weight calculator. This sidecar therefore declares its own normalized scale instead of pretending the runtime scale is frozen.
canonical_model_notes.ethics_policy: All demo actors use neutral ethics_score=1.0. Expertise is demonstrated separately from moral scoring.
canonical_model_notes.institution_rule: Institutional accounts are tagged as institutional profiles and should be read through a separately declared institutional-expertise lens, not silently mixed with individual merit.
canonical_model_notes.current_integration_gap: The current Canada/Quebec seed has EthikosTopic/EthikosStance data but no Smart Vote Consultation objects. Topic relevance in this sidecar must be mapped into a declared reading/consultation layer before the current ConsultationRelevance weight calculator can consume it.
